profile.headline: Freelance Videographer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer turned Videographer

I’m focused on building an intentional life where my work provides genuine, lasting value to the people I partner with. I’ve taken the logic and precision of my engineering years and am applying them to filmmaking. 

My goal is to deliver high-impact videos that drive measurable growth, expands your brand’s reach, and turns viewers into loyal customers.

positions.title: Freelance Videographer
positions.description:
What I focus on for my clients:

Strategic Storytelling: Identifying the "why" behind a project so the video drives real engagement and brand growth.

Technical Precision: Applying an engineer’s eye to lighting, composition, and post-production workflows.

Intentional Partnership: Operating with a service-first mindset to ensure every project provides genuine value to the project's bottom line.
